description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionDao class which provides data access methods for Employee US Tax Exemption entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to save an employee tax exemption record and retrieve such a record by employee number.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDao
classes.description: Data access object for handling employee US tax exemption data

methods.name: saveEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Saves an EmpUsTaxExemption entity to the database

methods.name: getEmployeeTaxExemption
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpUsTaxExemption entity for a given employee number
